rationale: The agent initiated and completed a return without first confirming the specific item or refund method with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The user requested a refund to the credit card, but the agent processed a refund to a gift card without explaining why a card refund was not possible. Although the agent looked up the user by name and zip and retrieved multiple orders, there is no explicit confirmation of identity beyond that, and no confirmation that the selected tablet was indeed the more expensive one. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and the chosen refund method contradicted the user’s preference.
